title: Zesty Rich Venezuelan Tamarind Empanadas
description: Rich, crumbly, romantic Venezuelan dish featuring tamarind pulp, perfect for a sugar-free friendly snack
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, puree the tamarind pulp until smooth.
In a large bowl, combine the corn flour, butter, and salt, and mix until crumbly.
Add the egg, water, and black pepper to the bowl, and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces, and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape, and place a tablespoon of tamarind puree in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling, and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with olive oil, and bake for 20 minutes.
